prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption, new_flow, finish, and home changes, as only one test has been completed for each.
For new_screen changes (2 tests), no clear effect was seen, with both leaning negative after noise correction.
No kind of change has proven helpful yet, as no test has shown a clear significant effect.
Predictions were consistently too high across all three tests compared to noise-corrected results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -1.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_screen: -2.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, hint] Photo Quality Guidance Hint: Add clear image requirements and lighting tips directly on the photo upload view. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or distorted results, and adoption retention is only 60.9%.)
1: [home, wait_info] Creation Status and Delay Tracker: Display progress indicators and accurate estimated completion times on the waiting screen. (why: The waiting step has a very high mean duration of 2336s, leading to drop-offs before completion.)
2: [choose_path, reorder] Deferred Sign-In Sequence: Reorder onboarding so users select their pet creation path before being asked to sign in. (why: Asking for sign-in upfront causes friction; letting users pick a path first builds intent.)
3: [finish, layout] Desktop Visibility Setup Layout: Update the home intro screen layout to split view focusing on desktop window positioning. (why: 3 support emails noted pets not appearing on screen or app failing to open after onboarding.)
4: [sign_in, copy] One-Click Sign-In Copy Refresh: Rewrite sign-in copy to emphasize fast account protection and instant setup. (why: Sign-in stage drops 27.1% of users despite low median completion time.)
5: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Certificate Builder Flow: Add a certificate personalization sub-flow allowing users to pick companion badges and names before finalizing adoption. (why: Adoption stage has the highest drop-off rate (60.9% conversion) and long completion times.)
6: [home, notification] Background Generation Notification: Enable desktop system alerts when pet generation finishes while minimized. (why: Home stage waiting time averages 2336s, indicating users switch away and forget to return.)

Addresses high wait time on home screen; supported by duration metrics.
Reduces upfront sign-in friction by deferring authentication.
Solves post-onboarding setup issues backed by 3 support emails and 35.2% drop-off.
